name: detail_cubes
description: SMOOTH base texturing — the @volmur/Hytale look. Assigns the texture to every chosen face (no untextured 'gaps'), then per face bakes a soft vertical gradient in the region colour + gentle directional shading (top lighter, underside darker) + a SUBTLE low-contrast mottle, and finally a 3x3 box blur per UV island (the 'smooth brush'). Run pack_uv FIRST, then this right after create_texture, then paint_faces for crisp features. Avoids the dirty/noisy/grid look (no hard edge outline, low noise by default). Cubes named *_core/*_glow are filled bright (emissive read).

base.description: Default base color, e.g. '#6e4a2b'. Used where no `colors` rule matches.

colors.description: Region colour map by cube name: [{match:'leg|paw', color:'#5a3d22'}, ...]. `match` is a regex tested case-insensitively against the cube name; first hit wins. The key to matching a reference palette and not making everything one colour.

cubes.description: 'all' (default), a single cube name/uuid, or an array of names/uuids to texture.

edge_darken.description: Edge outline darkening (default 0 = OFF; raising it brings back the dirty-grid look).

noise.description: Mottle amount 0..1 (default 0.06 — keep it LOW for the smooth look).

streaks.description: Add fur/wood/stone grain streaks on top/back faces (default false).

texture.description: Texture to paint on (defaults to the project's default texture).
